# Claudia Partner Docs

Public documentation for API 0.7.0-experimental. Documentation revision 15, pinned contract 2026-10-07. Runtime version and enabled features depend on the environment. MCP client 1.0.1 defines 8 import tools; all-service MCP is preparing. Examples are synthetic and have not been executed against customer environments.
